title: Integrations
intro: Where approved Documents go. Attach an Integration to the Forms it should receive.
emptyDescription: Without one, approving a Document just marks it approved. Add your system's endpoint to have Vink send the data there.
deleteDescription: It is detached from its Forms, and nothing is sent to it anymore.
signingSecretText: Every request carries an X-Vink-Signature header, {format}: HMAC-SHA256 of {signed} with this secret. Refuse a request whose t is more than 5 minutes old.
notAttached: Not attached to any Form yet.
lockedNote: An attached Form's keys are locked. Documents approved before attaching aren't sent.
googleConnected: Connected. Vink made the sheet in your Google Drive.
googleNoAccess: Vink didn't get access to make the sheet. Connect again and tick the box for Google Drive.
googleFailed: Connecting Google didn't work. Try again.

dialog.description: Vink POSTs each approved Document's Payload here as JSON, signed with this Integration's own secret.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.headersHint: For an API key, Bearer or Basic auth. Secret values are stored encrypted.
dialog.sheetsDescription: Vink adds a row per line of each approved Document to a new sheet in your Google Drive.
dialog.sheetNameHint: Also the name of the sheet Vink makes.
dialog.connectSignIn: You sign in with Google on its own page, then come back here.
dialog.connectAccess: Vink can only open the sheet it makes, none of your other files.
dialog.connectRows: Columns are the Form's Field keys. A new Field gets a new column on the right.

test.title: Send a test
test.description: Posts a signed envelope marked "test": true, so your receiver can check the format. It isn't a Delivery.
test.dataHint: Dummy data, or an Approved Document of this Form. Documents still in review are never sent.
test.sheetsDescription: Adds rows from this data to the sheet, with [test] before the filename. It isn't a Delivery.
